_why: P3330 (15/11/2026 Paris): exact couples of never-published held drivers carried by a published driver of the same class while the held id stays out of the Athom payload (the payload must stay <= the proven 347-driver ceiling, docs/knowledge/athom-driver-ceiling.md). prepare-publish appends these exact strings to the target payload entry only (source composes unchanged) and fails closed if that creates a couple already owned by another payload driver; at runtime the target driver maps these makers to deviceClass (same code the held driver runs). A fold is ignored once its held id is released or graduated.
